9.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words. Speaker labels that are not in the KJV were removed.

verses.text: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people. For you have gone a whoring (been unfaithful) from your God. You have loved a reward upon every cornfloor (grain floor).
The floor and the winepress shall not feed them. And the new wine shall fail in her.
They shall not dwell (live) in the LORD's land. But Ephraim shall return to Egypt. And they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.

They shall not offer wine offerings to the LORD. Neither shall their sacrifices be pleasing to Him. Their sacrifices shall be to them as the bread of mourners. All that eat of it shall be polluted (unclean). Their bread for their soul shall not come into the LORD's house.
What will you do in the solemn day (holy feast day)? What will you do in the day of the feast of the LORD?

For, lo (look), they are gone because of destruction. Egypt shall gather them up, and Memphis shall bury them. Nettles (weeds) shall possess their pleasant places for silver. Thorns shall be in their tabernacles (tents).

The days of visitation (punishment) are come. The days of recompence (payback) are come. Israel shall know it. The prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad (crazy). It is for the multitude (greatness) of your iniquity (sin), and the great hatred.
The watchman of Ephraim was with my God. But the prophet is a snare of a fowler (bird trap) in all his ways. And he is hatred in the house of his God.
They have deeply corrupted (ruined) themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. Therefore He will remember their iniquity (sin). He will visit (punish) their sins.

I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness (desert). I saw your fathers as the firstripe (first ripe) figs. They were the fig tree's first fruit. But they went to Baalpeor (a false god). They separated themselves to that shame. And their abominations (hateful things) were as they loved.
As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird. It shall go from the birth, and from the womb. It shall go from the conception (becoming pregnant).
Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave (take away) them. There shall not be a man left. Yes, woe (great trouble) also to them when I depart (go away) from them!
Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus (Tyre), is planted in a pleasant place. But Ephraim shall bring forth (out) his children to the murderer.
Give them, O LORD: what will You give? Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.

All their wickedness is in Gilgal. For there I hated them. For the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of My house. I will love them no more. All their princes (leaders) are revolters (rebels).

Ephraim is smitten (struck down), their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit. Yes, though they bring forth (have children), yet will I slay (kill) them. I will slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken (listen) to Him. And they shall be wanderers among the nations.

10.source: Rewritten 2026-11-22 fresh from the public-domain King James Version (the earlier text was a loose paraphrase), checked against the Hebrew, at a simple, Deaf-friendly reading level with hard KJV words explained in parentheses, and no sentence over 14 words. V6 keeps the KJV's king Jareb. V12 keeps break up your fallow ground.

verses.text: Israel is an empty vine. He brings forth (makes) fruit to himself. According to the multitude (amount) of his fruit he has increased the altars. According to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images (idols).
Their heart is divided. Now shall they be found faulty. He (the LORD) shall break down their altars. He shall spoil (destroy) their images (idols).
For now they shall say: We have no king, because we feared not the LORD. What then should a king do to us?
They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making an agreement. Thus judgment springs up as hemlock (poison weeds) in the furrows of the field.

The inhabitants (people) of Samaria shall fear because of the calves (calf idols) of Bethaven. For the people of it shall mourn over it. And the priests of it rejoiced on it, for the glory of it. But it is departed (gone) from it.
It shall be also carried to Assyria for a present to king Jareb. Ephraim shall receive shame. And Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel (plans).
As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.

The high places (idol altars) also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed. The thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars. And they shall say to the mountains: Cover us. And they shall say to the hills: Fall on us.
O Israel, you have sinned from the days of Gibeah. There they stood. The battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity (sin) did not overtake them.
It is in My desire that I should chastise (punish) them. And the people shall be gathered against them. They shall bind themselves in their 2 furrows (for their 2 sins).

And Ephraim is as an heifer (young cow) that is taught. She loves to tread out the corn (grain). But I passed over upon her fair (beautiful) neck. I will make Ephraim to ride. Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods (dirt).

Sow (plant) to yourselves in righteousness, reap (harvest) in mercy. Break up your fallow ground (hard unplowed ground). For it is time to seek the LORD. Seek Him till He come and rain righteousness upon you.
You have plowed wickedness. You have reaped (harvested) iniquity (sin). You have eaten the fruit of lies. For you did trust in your way, in the multitude (great number) of your mighty men.

Therefore shall a tumult (roar of war) arise among your people. And all your fortresses shall be spoiled (destroyed). It will be as Shalman spoiled (destroyed) Betharbel in the day of battle. The mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
So shall Bethel do to you because of your great wickedness. In a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
